_comment: Verbatim assessment-objective decomposition of NIST SP 800-171 Revision 2's 110 requirements, from NIST SP 800-171A ("Assessing Security Requirements for Controlled Unclassified Information") version 1.0.0, which pairs with Rev 2 (docs/open-questions.md Q4's "Adjacent CPRT datasets" note; version 3.0.0 pairs with Rev 3 instead and is out of scope). Extracted from NIST's Cybersecurity and Privacy Reference Tool (CPRT), same framework family as gen/sources/800-171r2.json, via the endpoint recorded below. Every requirement id here is exactly one of catalogs/800-171r2.json's 110 control ids — verified by set equality at curation time, not just at compile time. Each requirement decomposes into 1-15 lettered determination statements (e.g. "3.1.1[a]".."[f]"; a requirement with exactly one determination keeps the bare requirement id, per NIST's own CPRT identifiers, which is why not every objective id carries a bracket). assessment_methods is recorded per REQUIREMENT, not per objective: NIST's own data model attaches one EXAMINE/INTERVIEW/TEST triple of candidate evidence sources to the requirement as a whole, not to individual determination statements, so an objectives-catalog schema that carried a per-objective method-class field would be inventing a distinction the source does not make. Rev 2 (and therefore its 800-171A companion) is withdrawn and will never change, so this is a one-time acquisition, not a refresh cycle.
